name: q3-independent-research-v1
research_distribution: Existing random_scenario(3, seed): uniform N in 10..16, exclusive sampled channels, uniform area in radius-1800 disk, uniform reception radius in 1000..1500; this is an assumption, not the official generator law.

acceptance.confidence_scope: Per predeclared branch contrast, not a simultaneous guarantee for a post-hoc selected winner. Report both branches.

failure_policy: Retain every attempted case. Failed runs receive 360000 seconds for penalty summaries, never treat their truncated raw time as a speed win. Performance acceptance requires complete success over the frozen final suite. Missing cases invalidate completion.
final_access_policy: Do not run final or future-reserved seeds during development or training. Freeze selected code/config/checkpoints before opening final evaluation. Further tuning after viewing final results requires a new independent test partition.
official_policy: Practice only. No formal tests without explicit user instruction. Official practice cases differ and are not causal paired comparisons.
